purpose: A normal cfg(test) body mutation must be detected even while the same opaque macro causes a review item.
before:
macro_rules! opaque { () => { #[cfg(test)] fn hidden() { 7 } }; }
#[cfg(test)] fn normal_test() { assert_eq!(1, 1); }
after:
macro_rules! opaque { () => { #[cfg(test)] fn hidden() { 7 } }; }
#[cfg(test)] fn normal_test() { assert_eq!(1, 2); }
